newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-SAKU HOLDS 48 PERCENT OF BEER MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-SAKU HOLDS 48 PERCENT OF BEER MARKET.

text.p: Saku brewery said on Wednesday that during the first six months of 1997 it held 48 percent of Estonia's domestic beer market.

In a statement, Saku said that its calculations showed its rivals in the bottled and keg beer market were Tartu Brewery with 14 percent, imported beers with 11 percent and other smaller local breweries with 25 percent.
Saku's sales volume for the first six months of 1997 was 13.8 million litres of which 480,000 litres were exported.
Domestic sales increased by six percent compared to the same period in 1996.
The main export markets for Saku were Ukraine, Finland and the United States.
Saku is traded on the free market of the Tallinn stock exchange and is majority owned by Batlic Beverages Holdings which is made up of and Norwegian Orkla .
